title: Fix: login timeout on slow networks
body: Users report login fails after 30s on 3G connections. The auth service timeout is set to 15s which is too aggressive. Need to increase timeout and add retry logic.

title: Feat: add dark mode toggle to settings
body: Add a dark mode toggle in user settings. Should persist preference to localStorage and apply CSS class to document root. Include system preference detection as default.

title: Refactor: extract validation logic to shared module
body: The email/phone/password validation is duplicated across 5 components. Extract to src/utils/validators.py with consistent error messages and unit tests.
